get.description: Retrieve a list of all work orders.

200.description: List of work orders returned successfully.

post.description: Add a new work order to the system. Supports idempotent creation via Idempotency-Key header to prevent duplicate workorders.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate creation (recommended for retries)

200.description: Work order created successfully, or existing work order returned if idempotency key was previously processed.

post.description: Start work on a work order, transitioning it to WORK_IN_PROGRESS status.

parameters.name: workorderId
parameters.description: ID of the work order to start

400.description: Invalid state transition or pending change requests.

post.description: Start tracking labor on a specific service item. Only one active session allowed per service.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate starts

400.description: Invalid state - active session exists or invalid status

post.description: Controlled reopen for completed workorders. Requires elevated permission and mandatory reason.

parameters.name: workorderId
parameters.description: ID of the completed workorder to reopen

400.description: Workorder cannot be reopened or reason missing.

post.description: Replace one part with another. Original part preserved for history.

400.description: Invalid request (part already consumed, etc.)

post.description: Return unused parts after partial consumption or service completion

400.description: Invalid request (exceeds available quantity, etc.)

post.description: Return unused part quantity beyond normal return flow

400.description: Invalid request (exceeds available quantity, etc.)

post.description: Issue parts from inventory, reserving them for consumption on the workorder

400.description: Invalid request (negative quantity, etc.)

post.description: Administrative correction for data entry errors

400.description: Invalid request

post.description: Record actual consumption of parts. Quantity consumed cannot exceed quantity issued.

400.description: Invalid request (exceeds issued quantity, etc.)

parameters.name: entryId
parameters.description: ID of the labor entry to stop

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate stops

400.description: Session already stopped

post.description: Complete a work order, transitioning it to COMPLETED status and emitting a WorkCompleted event.

parameters.name: workorderId
parameters.description: ID of the work order to complete

400.description: Invalid state transition or work order already completed.

get.summary: Get all change requests for a work order
get.description: Retrieve all change requests associated with a specific work order

post.description: Technician creates a request for additional work beyond authorized scope. Items are marked as PENDING_APPROVAL until advisor approves. Requires description and at least one service or part item. Supports idempotent creation via Idempotency-Key header to prevent duplicate change requests.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate creation (recommended for retries)

200.description: Change request created successfully, or existing change request returned if idempotency key was previously processed

400.description: Invalid request - missing description, no items, or validation failed

post.summary: Approve a work order with customer signature
post.description: Transition work order to APPROVED status with customer signature capture. Work order can be approved from DRAFT status. Requires customer ID validation and signature data (base64-encoded image).

parameters.name: workorderId
parameters.description: ID of the work order to approve

400.description: Work order cannot be approved in current state or customer ID mismatch.

200.description: Work order approved successfully with signature captured.

get.description: Retrieve a list of all estimates.

post.description: Create a new estimate in DRAFT status for a customer and vehicle. Requires ESTIMATE_CREATE permission. System will generate a unique estimate number and apply default values for location, currency, and tax region if not provided.

400.description: Invalid request - missing required fields.

500.description: Internal server error - estimate creation failed.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have ESTIMATE_CREATE permission.

post.description: Submit a DRAFT estimate for customer approval. Creates immutable snapshot and transitions to PENDING_APPROVAL state. Validates completeness (has customer, vehicle, line items, calculated totals). CAP:003 Issue #168 - Submit Estimate for Customer Approval

parameters.name: estimateId
parameters.description: ID of the estimate to submit

400.description: Estimate is incomplete or not in DRAFT state

post.description: Capture an immutable snapshot of the estimate's complete state (estimate + all line items) for audit trail and version history purposes.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Optional notes about why snapshot was created

post.description: Transition a declined estimate back to DRAFT state. Can only be done within the configured expiry period.

parameters.name: estimateId
parameters.description: ID of the estimate to reopen

400.description: Estimate cannot be reopened (not declined or expired).

post.description: Promote an approved estimate to a workorder. Validates preconditions: estimate must be APPROVED, not expired, have approved items, and not already promoted. Returns 409 ALREADY_PROMOTED with existingWorkorderId if estimate was previously promoted (idempotency). CAP:004 Story #26 - Create Workorder from Approved Estimate.

parameters.name: estimateId
parameters.description: ID of the estimate to promote

409.description: Estimate already promoted (ALREADY_PROMOTED) or approval invalid/expired

400.description: Validation error - estimate not in correct state

post.description: Add a part or labor line item to a draft estimate. Estimate must be in DRAFT status. For PART items, provide productId or description. For LABOR items, provide serviceId or description.

400.description: Validation error or invalid request

post.description: Transition estimate to declined state. Estimate can be declined from DRAFT or APPROVED status.

parameters.name: estimateId
parameters.description: ID of the estimate to decline

400.description: Estimate cannot be declined in current state.

post.description: Calculate subtotal, tax amount, and total for an estimate based on its line items. Estimate must be in DRAFT status. Uses stub tax calculation (8.25% flat rate) pending pos-accounting integration.

post.summary: Approve an estimate with customer signature
post.description: Transition estimate to approved state with customer signature capture. Estimate can be approved from DRAFT status. Requires customer ID validation and signature data (base64-encoded image). For commercial accounts with PO enforcement enabled, a purchase order number must be provided (CAP:092 Story #98).

parameters.name: estimateId
parameters.description: ID of the estimate to approve

400.description: Estimate cannot be approved in current state, customer ID mismatch, or PO required but not provided.

200.description: Estimate approved successfully with signature captured.

post.description: Manager applies emergency override to approve a change request with exception. Requires Manager role and a valid exception reason. Items move from PENDING_APPROVAL to READY_TO_EXECUTE status.

400.description: Cannot apply override - invalid state or missing reason

post.description: Service Advisor declines the change request. Items move from PENDING_APPROVAL to CANCELLED status (not billable). Approval note is required to record the decline decision.

400.description: Cannot decline - invalid state or missing note

post.description: Service Advisor approves the change request. Items move from PENDING_APPROVAL to READY_TO_EXECUTE status. Approval note is required as the approval artifact.

400.description: Cannot approve - invalid state or missing approval note

post.description: For declined emergency/safety items, record that customer acknowledged the denial. Required before closing the work order and returning the vehicle.

400.description: Not an emergency request or invalid state

post.description: Add a new approval configuration.
Calculate tax for line items based on location. Routes to external service in production or test calculator in test mode.

delete.description: Remove a line item from a draft estimate (soft delete). Estimate must be in DRAFT status.

patch.description: Update an existing line item on a draft estimate. Estimate must be in DRAFT status. Only provided fields will be updated.

400.description: Validation error or invalid request
